privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: How PDF Conduit handles your files — in short: it doesn't keep them.
privacy.memoryBody: Your files are never stored. Each operation runs entirely within a single request — your upload is processed and streamed straight back to you, then discarded the moment it's done. Nothing is kept, and nothing is ever used for anything else.
privacy.exceptionBody: Converting office or text documents (for example .docx, .xlsx, .pptx) requires a headless LibreOffice. For that step only, the file is written to an isolated temporary folder that is deleted immediately after the conversion completes. Plain PDFs and images never touch the disk.
privacy.accountBody: You don't need to sign up, log in, or give us an email address to use the free tools. We don't require personal information to process a file.
privacy.limitsBody1: To keep the free service available to everyone, requests are subject to a daily operation quota, a per-file size cap and basic rate limiting. When you hit a limit, the app tells you clearly. Higher limits, larger files and batch/API access are planned for a future paid tier — see the
privacy.questionsBody: PDF Conduit is provided as-is. This page describes our current behaviour and may be updated as the product evolves.
